verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Anrok tracks foreign registration thresholds and obligations across multiple countries (world exposure map, UK registration threshold tracker, tax obligations in 13 countries, automatic registration in 13 jurisdictions) and supports filings/payments generally. However, there is no explicit mention of EU OSS/IOSS mechanisms, VAT/GST-specific handling, or explicit coverage of Canada/Australia GST beyond generic 'beyond' claims — the evidence is US-sales-tax-centric with only vague international dashboard mentions. Missing for 10: explicit OSS/IOSS scheme support, named VAT/GST jurisdictions (EU, UK, Canada, Australia) with filing mechanics, and independent corroboration of international filing accuracy.
